prompt: Create a minimalist cultural-art poster on a vertical 4:5 canvas. The entire image is a close-up macro surface of warm translucent beeswax over fibrous handmade paper, in muted honey, amber, ochre, and beige tones. Use very low, raking light from the upper left so the wax texture, faint paper fibers, cloudy marbling, tiny scratches, hairline cracks, and shallow relief become visible only subtly. Center the composition around one large broken circular symbol: a thick incomplete ring shaped like a capital C, positioned slightly above center. The left half of the ring is exposed dark reddish-brown embedded organic fiber or resin, rough and granular, while the right half continues as a very faint ghost impression beneath the wax, almost disappearing into the surface. The ring has exactly 2 visible open gaps, one at the top and one at the bottom, both near the right side of the exposed C shape. Near the lower third, emboss exactly 5 Chinese characters reading 被时间封存; the characters are pressed into the wax rather than printed, low contrast, glossy on the beveled edges, visible mainly by shadows and highlights. No other text, no border, no logo, no frame. Keep the mood quiet, slow, archival, tactile, and meditative, suitable for fragrance, cultural publishing, or contemporary art branding. Photorealistic macro material rendering, soft vignette toward the edges, shallow tonal contrast, squarely front-facing poster view with the title nearly hidden in the wax.
